title: Computational Science Graduate School
summary: A personal repository of coursework and lab exercises for a Computational Science graduate program, including notebooks for classes like Computational Intelligence and Machine Learning. One lab script imports the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic data from a flood dataset.
evidence: CTAN.py:5,13-15: 'from ctgan import CTGANSynthesizer' then 'ctgan.fit(data, continuous_columns, epochs=10)' and 'ctgan.sample(207)'
needs: Confirm whether this predates the SDV-family rename or is the old standalone ctgan package (CTGANSynthesizer class name suggests an early ctgan version).
